notes: Only assigned unfinished original fields examined. Other fields are unassigned null placeholders. PDF pp. 16–17 inspected for layout, metric symbols and signs; evidence quotes retain canonical text. The description names the unspecified condition under salient fairness without a comparator. Candidates are unearned versus unspecified, earned versus unspecified, and salient versus neutral fairness within unspecified. No unique critical contrast is identified. The full model sample is 251 participants after five manipulation-check exclusions; condition counts are not supplied. No comparator is specified for the salient-fairness unspecified-resource condition. Candidates: unearned versus unspecified (PDF t=-2.05, d=-0.42, p<.05), earned versus unspecified (t=0.84, d=0.18, p>.40), or neutral versus salient fairness within unspecified (t=1.14, PDF d=-0.25, p>.25). No candidate selected. No comparator is specified for the salient-fairness unspecified-resource condition. Candidates: unearned versus unspecified (PDF t=-2.05, d=-0.42, p<.05), earned versus unspecified (t=0.84, d=0.18, p>.40), or neutral versus salient fairness within unspecified (t=1.14, PDF d=-0.25, p>.25). No candidate selected.
